notes: Each preset is produced by one strict Sisyphus predict() call.
Final Cmax, component tracks, effective weights, and the residual interval are read from CmaxPrediction.
The curve, Tmax, AUC, half-life, solver status, and mass balance are read from the same EngineSimulation; no second solve or curve rescaling is performed.
This repeatedly accessed development benchmark is not an independent holdout.
